issues.title: A boss's health can refill when one of you dies
issues.body: Seen with Oggdo Bogdo on Bogano: when either player died, the boss went back to full health, and after respawning it could ignore the player who had died.

issues.title: A cutscene can start for one of you before the other
issues.body: Story scenes always play for both of you, but sometimes not at the same moment. A few things can then look different in your two games for a while.

issues.title: Spiders can keep appearing during a cutscene
issues.body: On Dathomir, spiders kept appearing for one player while a cutscene played, and a large group was waiting when it ended.

issues.title: A rope shortcut one of you opens may stay closed for the other
issues.body: When one player cuts down or unlocks a rope shortcut, it may not open in their friend's game.

issues.title: Chests give both of you the same cosmetic
issues.body: With the co-op setting that gives each of you your own chest cosmetic, both players can still get the same item.

issues.title: Your friend's poncho can look like a different one
issues.body: A poncho can show in the wrong style on the other player's screen.
issues.workaround: The player wearing it leaves the journey and joins again. It then shows correctly.

issues.title: A controller can't pick a journey under YOUR JOURNEYS
issues.body: In Join Journey, a journey you've joined before can't be selected with a controller.
issues.workaround: Type the host's join code in the code boxes instead (up and down change the letter), or click the journey with the mouse.

issues.title: You may not hear an enemy that's fighting your friend
issues.body: When an enemy is busy with the other player, some of its sounds can be missing on your side. Seen in the Oggdo Bogdo fight.

issues.title: Enemies led away from their spot may not show up for your friend
issues.body: If one of you leads enemies a long way from where they started, your friend's game may not show them until your friend gets close to where they began.

issues.title: You couldn't parry blaster shots aimed at your friend
issues.body: Shots fired at your friend are now real in your game too: you can block and parry them where you see them.

issues.title: Co-op could stop after the host respawned or rode a lift
issues.body: Co-op no longer stops for the rest of the session after the host dies and respawns, or rides a lift.

issues.title: The game could crash when some enemies came into view
issues.body: With some enemies, such as Purge troopers, the game could close without warning when they came into view during co-op. This is fixed.

issues.title: Shortcuts your friend opened stayed shut after you rejoined
issues.body: When the host had opened a shortcut in an earlier session, it stayed shut for a joining player. Shortcuts the host has opened are now open for you as soon as you join.

issues.title: Force Slow looked different in your friend's game
issues.body: Slowing a puzzle object with the Force now looks the same in both games.

issues.title: Enemies got tougher every time a player rejoined
issues.body: With Tougher or Toughest, enemies no longer gain extra health each time a player leaves and joins again.
